GENERATED MEMO:
# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM
**ONEOK, INC. - CREDIT FACILITY EXTENSION**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** May 8, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** ONEOK, Inc., an Oklahoma corporation, operating in the midstream energy sector.

**Transaction Description:** Extension Agreement for an existing credit facility originally dated June 10, 2022. The transaction involves ONEOK, Inc. as borrower, with guarantors including ONEOK Partners Intermediate Limited Partnership, ONEOK Partners, L.P., and Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. Citibank, N.A. serves as Administrative Agent, Swing Line Lender, and L/C Issuer, with a syndicate of 21 consenting lenders.

**Purpose of Financing:** Extension of the maturity date of an existing credit facility from June 10, 2027 to June 10, 2028, pursuant to Section 2.15 of the original Credit Agreement.

**Company Background:** ONEOK, Inc. is a midstream energy company with operations spanning natural gas liquids and natural gas infrastructure. The company has partnerships with related entities including ONEOK Partners, L.P. and acquired assets from Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P., which now serves as a guarantor on the facility.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Strong Lender Support:** Extension approved by lenders holding more than 50% of aggregate commitments, demonstrating broad syndicate confidence
• **Robust Guarantor Structure:** Multiple guarantors including ONEOK Partners entities and Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. providing credit enhancement
• **Established Banking Relationships:** High-quality syndicate led by Citibank with major financial institutions including Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, and other tier-1 lenders
• **Operational Continuity:** All existing loan document covenants and obligations remain in full force and effect, providing consistent credit protections

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Commodity Price Exposure:** As a midstream energy company, ONEOK faces exposure to energy market volatility
• **Extension Fee Impact:** Borrower paying separately negotiated fees to consenting lenders for the extension
• **Refinancing Risk:** One-year extension provides limited runway before next maturity event in June 2028

---

## 3. KEY DEAL TERMS

| **Term** | **Details** |
|----------|-------------|
| **Deal Size** | N/A |
| **Deal Price** | Extension fee in amount separately agreed with each consenting lender |
| **Interest Rate** | N/A |
| **Original Maturity Date** | June 10, 2027 |
| **Extended Maturity Date** | June 10, 2028 |
| **Payment Frequency** | N/A |
| **Administrative Agent** | Citibank, N.A. |
| **Key Covenants** | All existing covenants and financial maintenance terms from original Credit Agreement remain in effect |
| **Guarantors** | ONEOK Partners Intermediate Limited Partnership, ONEOK Partners, L.P., and Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. |
| **Governing Law** | New York |

---

**ONEOK, INC. - CREDIT FACILITY EXTENSION**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** May 8, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** ONEOK, Inc., an Oklahoma corporation, operating in the midstream energy sector.

**Transaction Description:** Extension Agreement for an existing credit facility originally dated June 10, 2022. The transaction involves ONEOK, Inc. as borrower, with guarantors including ONEOK Partners Intermediate Limited Partnership, ONEOK Partners, L.P., and Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. Citibank, N.A. serves as Administrative Agent, Swing Line Lender, and L/C Issuer, with a syndicate of 21 consenting lenders.

**Purpose of Financing:** Extension of the maturity date of an existing credit facility from June 10, 2027 to June 10, 2028, pursuant to Section 2.15 of the original Credit Agreement.

**Company Background:** ONEOK, Inc. is a midstream energy company with operations spanning natural gas liquids and natural gas infrastructure. The company has partnerships with related entities including ONEOK Partners, L.P. and acquired assets from Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P., which now serves as a guarantor on the facility.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Strong Lender Support:** Extension approved by lenders holding more than 50% of aggregate commitments, demonstrating broad syndicate confidence
• **Robust Guarantor Structure:** Multiple guarantors including ONEOK Partners entities and Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. providing credit enhancement
• **Established Banking Relationships:** High-quality syndicate led by Citibank with major financial institutions including Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, and other tier-1 lenders
• **Operational Continuity:** All existing loan document covenants and obligations remain in full force and effect, providing consistent credit protections

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Commodity Price Exposure:** As a midstream energy company, ONEOK faces exposure to energy market volatility
• **Extension Fee Impact:** Borrower paying separately negotiated fees to consenting lenders for the extension
• **Refinancing Risk:** One-year extension provides limited runway before next maturity event in June 2028

---

| **Extended Maturity Date** | June 10, 2028 |
| **Payment Frequency** | N/A |

| **Key Covenants** | All existing covenants and financial maintenance terms from original Credit Agreement remain in effect |
| **Guarantors** | ONEOK Partners Intermediate Limited Partnership, ONEOK Partners, L.P., and Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. |
| **Governing Law** | New York |
